cards.name: Unlock younger audiences: fix publishing warning + reach 250 qualifying players
cards.description:
## Goal

Qualify BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET for younger audiences through Roblox Kids/Select. Keep the horror questionnaire truthful.

## Kontrolleret 9. september 2026

- Manage kunne åbnes. Account status, ID, Age check og 2-step verification var opfyldt; handlingsknapperne viste Done. Kontoens status: **Publish to all ages**.
- Oplevelsens Reach: **16+ and trusted friends**; group reach All ages. “Publishing tier at risk” var stadig vist. Advarslens præcise årsag er ikke fastslået.
- Publishing fee: **Not submitted**. Ingen betaling eller kontoændring udført.
- Kvalificerende spillere: **30/250**, senest opdateret **8/9**. Ikke CCU eller almindelige visits.
- Indhold: **Mild — Fear (Repeated/Mild)**.

[Audience Reach](https://create.roblox.com/dashboard/creations/experiences/10559217407/audience-reach)

## Fortsat åbent

Owner-only adgangsblokeringen er løst. Kontoens grønne krav er ikke bevis for, at spillets advarsel, evaluering eller yngre adgang er løst.

Afklar advarslen og oplevelsens fee-/abonnementsstatus. Den normale vej kræver sikkerhedsevaluering og 250 unikke kvalificerende, højt engagerede alderskontrollerede spillere i 60-dagesvinduet. Brug Roblox' tæller; køb i vores spil kræves ikke.

Kvalificerende Plus/Premium i 2 sammenhængende måneder eller 1.000 Robux er alternative publiceringsveje; ingen betaling vælges automatisk. Ekspederet review til 100.000 er valgfrit. Verificér vilkår ved evt. senere betaling.

Done først når evaluering og faktisk adgang til den ønskede yngre målgruppe er bekræftet, med gældende forældre-/regionsregler. Følg checklisterne. **Kortet forbliver åbent.**

Historik: 6/9 blev LaverSneglen afvist i Manage; 30/250 var dateret 4/9. Original bevaret i docs/TRELLO_SNAPSHOT_2026-09-09.json.

[Eligibility](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/publishing/kids-and-select)
[Fees](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/publishing/publish-games-and-places#optional-fees)
[Maturity](https://create.roblox.com/docs/production/promotion/content-maturity)

cards.name: Alert developers when an in-game purchase is completed
cards.description:
## Goal

Send a real-time Discord notification whenever a verified in-game purchase succeeds in **BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET**.

## Destination

Use a **private developer-only channel** in the game/community Discord server, suggested name: `#dev-purchase-alerts`. Regular players and community members must not be able to see the channel or notifications. Only approved developer/admin roles should have access.

## Alert contents

- Product name and ID
- Actual Robux paid
- Player username and user ID
- Timestamp
- Purchase ID for deduplication
- Server/place ID when useful

Example:

> 💰 NEW PURCHASE
> Product: Emergency Re-entry
> Price: 25 Robux
> Player: ExamplePlayer (123456)
> Time: 14:32 UTC

## Security and reliability

- Trigger only from the server after Roblox verification through the existing `MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt` flow.
- Never use `PromptProductPurchaseFinished` as proof of payment.
- Preserve existing receipt granting and permanent deduplication.
- Never expose the Discord webhook URL to clients. Prefer a secure external relay/endpoint.
- Notification delivery must be separate and best-effort: Discord failure must never delay or reject the player's grant.
- Deduplicate notifications by `PurchaseId` when Roblox retries receipts.
- Do not transmit unnecessary personal information.
- Rate-limit requests and never log webhook secrets.

## Done when

- One successful test purchase creates exactly one private Discord alert.
- The alert contains the correct product, amount, player and time.
- Community members cannot access the channel.
- Discord failure does not affect the purchase grant.
- Receipt retry creates no duplicate alert.
- Test evidence and implementation are documented before publishing.

cards.name: Rehink the "Top Supporter" sign. Center and enlarge the text.
Add entity sounds for level 2: Wait for sound IDs
Fix the hide under the table avatar animation in level 3.

Level 1: Make the instructions much clearer and more accessible. Display a text prompt to the entire team whenever a player picks up a fuse, powers a fuse box, or pulls a lever. Each prompt should clearly state who performed the action, what they did, and what the team needs to do next, while matching the game’s existing UI design.

For example, if more fuse boxes still need to be powered, clearly tell the team how many remain. This should apply throughout the entire level so players always understand their current objective and next step.

Also, make the cables show a subtle but clearly visible electrical current flowing toward the fuse box. Once the fuse box is powered, the current should reverse direction and flow toward the lever, visually guiding players to where they need to go next. At the same time, display a prompt instructing the team to follow the current and pull the lever.
cards.description:
Før større ads — prioritet P1 (15/9/2026). Dette eksisterende kort dækker punkt 3: forståeligt første objective. Bevar alle krav i kortets titel om team-prompts, resterende objectives og strømretning i kablerne.

Acceptkriterier:
• Vis én konkret næste handling: hvorhen, hvilken interaktion og hvad den ændrede.
• Førstegangsspillere skal kunne løse første objective uden mundtlig hjælp fra en ven; gennemfør observerede tests på mobil og PC.
• Kontrollér tilsvarende forståelighed ved første objective i Level 2 og 3; registrér eventuelle mangler før implementering.
• Mål tid til første objective og frafald før/efter. Luk først efter dokumenteret brugertest; der er ikke konstateret en konkret fejl alene ud fra analytics.

cards.description:

cards.name: Add progressive playtime rewards, starting after 5 minutes
cards.description:
Add a rewards system that grants tokens or in-game items based on how long a player has played.

The first reward should be available after 5 minutes. Later rewards should require progressively longer playtime and give more rewards. The remaining milestones and reward amounts are yet to be determined.

cards.name: Add a daily lucky wheel for tokens and other rewards
cards.description: Add a lucky wheel that each player can spin once per day to win tokens or other in-game rewards. The prize pool and reward amounts are yet to be determined.

cards.name: Explore more token-purchasable items, including a Speed Boost Potion
cards.description:
Find more in-game items players can buy with tokens. Include a Speed Boost Potion as a proposed item.

The potion's token price, speed increase, and duration are yet to be determined.

Build on the earlier completed token-item research: https://trello.com/c/O0h3ag8I

cards.name: Fix pathfinding for the pool mouth entity in level 2, its stops up.
Make a temporay 14 days sales on every purchase, make it 50% on everything.

Create more purchasable, high-quality items for the shop, and make sure every item actually works correctly after purchase.  Rethink the entire shop experience. Instead of a basic shop, create an actual **SHOP area built into the wall**, with a large **SHOP** sign using Zyntra’s neon colors. It should feel extremely inviting and immediately make players curious enough to walk over and explore it.  For the physical shop, experiment with something like **pressure-plate purchase displays**. Each purchasable item could have its own display or pedestal, with a box or representation of the item hovering above it. Make the products visually exciting and obvious to interact with. Use image generation to create custom textures/assets for the purchasable items so they feel native to Zyntra rather than like generic placeholders.  Also redesign the **SHOP UI icon** to increase visibility and clicks. Give it a strong circular border treatment, potentially with a subtle animated/glowing/pulsing effect around the edge using Zyntra’s visual identity. It should attract attention without becoming annoying.  Overall, treat the shop as a major part of the game rather than just another UI menu. The goal is to make players **notice it → become curious → interact with the products → understand what they are buying → actually want to purchase them**.
Add Daily Rewards as a tab, just like Shop and Upgrades, but make it bouge.
cards.description:
Før større ads — prioritet P2 (15/9/2026). Bevar ønsket om en flot Daily Rewards-fane i spillets eksisterende stil. Dette kort samler opfølgningen på punkt 8: en konkret grund til at vende tilbage.

Koordinér med eksisterende kort, så samme belønningssystem ikke bygges flere gange:
[https://trello.com/c/4DOb30AO](https://trello.com/c/4DOb30AO "‌") — daily lucky wheel
[https://trello.com/c/NP80aPPC](https://trello.com/c/NP80aPPC "‌") — progressive playtime rewards

Acceptkriterier:
• Spilleren kan se sin fremgang, hvad næste besøg giver, og hvornår næste reward kan hentes.
• Vurder også gemt level-adgang, samleobjekter eller meningsfuld variation mellem runs; vælg et konkret replay-greb, der passer til horror-spillet, frem for automatisk at bygge alle forslag.
• Verificér gemt progression og rewards ved leave/rejoin.
• Mål D1 og D7 for færdige spillerkohorter før/efter, opdelt efter mobil/PC og trafikkilde. D7 på 0,02 % i screenshot er et undersøgelsessignal, ikke dokumentation for årsagen.
• Målet er lyst til endnu en gennemspilning, ikke kun at lade spillet stå åbent for belønninger.

cards.name: Make all lobby colors more saturated.
Donation leaderboard: Include all in-game purchases
cards.description:
Include all in-game purchases in the donation leaderboard, alongside direct donations. Players who have bought anything in the game should also appear on the leaderboard, with their purchases contributing to their total.

---
Delleverance publiceret 10. september 2026 kl. 00:22:23.542 dansk tid — v1824, via mus i Studio-menuen.

Nye Developer Product-kvitteringer for Tokens4, Tokens20 og Emergency Re-entry bidrager nu med faktisk CurrencySpent. DonationRobux bevares særskilt; UtilityRobux og den afledte RecordedSupportRobux indgår i personlig visning og støttetavlen. Kvitterings-ID, beløb og købsfordel gemmes atomisk i den eksisterende profiltransaktion. Permanent deduplikering og v2-rangeringens monotone max/kø bevares, også for fraværende donorer. Studio-grants skaber ingen betalt støttetotal.

Verificeret: 236 fokuserede receipt/cache-checks, 242 eksisterende token-grant-checks, native desktop/telefon i begge retninger og tavle med læsbar scope-footer. Uafhængig kritiker: 9/10. Før publicering: 122/122 scripts kompilerede, ingen staged scripts, audit 122 matched/0 drift (én tilladt LF-forskel). Native bevis og releasejournal: artifacts/trello-20260909/support-products-native.json og support-products-validation.md.

Kortet er fortsat In Progress og ikke complete. Passes og tidligere token/re-entry-køb er endnu ikke afstemt. Salgseksport kræver ejerens authenticator; Studio-læsning af live DataStores er blokeret af deaktiveret API-adgang, så gamle stores er ikke erklæret tomme. Ingen katalogprisgæt, migration, CSV-import eller sletning af historik er udført. Ældre serverversioner kan fortsat anerkende utility-køb uden den nye beløbsstream, indtil de erstattes; publiceringstidspunktet er derfor ikke en global historisk skæringsdato.

cards.name: Add in-game voice chat (VC)
cards.description:
Enable in-game voice chat so players can talk to each other while playing BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET.

Done when: Voice chat has been enabled and verified between players in-game.

## Konfiguration kontrolleret — 9. september 2026

Native Studio UI: File → Experience Settings → Communication viste Enable Voice Chat slået til. Save var deaktiveret; der blev ikke ændret indstillinger. Dialogen blev lukket med Cancel.

Read-only Edit-probe: VoiceChatService.EnableDefaultVoice=true, UseAudioApi=Enabled, Players.MaxPlayers=60. De to service-egenskaber er kontrolleret særskilt fra oplevelsens overordnede toggle. Loftet på 60 opfylder Roblox' maksimale 100 spillere for VC.

Kritikerens score for den afgrænsede konfigurationsaudit: **9/10**. Dette er ikke bevis for gennemført samtaletest eller en ny featurepublicering.

**Testing:** To kvalificerede spillere skal mødes i publiceret spil og verificere tale i begge retninger, afstandsdæmpning og Roblox' mute. Det er stadig åbent; kortet er ikke Done.

[Officiel VC-vejledning](https://create.roblox.com/docs/chat/voice-chat)
Repo-dokumentation: artifacts/trello-20260909/dashboard-verification.md.

Supplerende observation under Shop-Playtest, dokumenteret 10/9: Native Roblox CoreGUI viste "Not Eligible for Voice — This account is not eligible to use Spatial Voice." Desktop-/telefonbilleder i shop-button-native-materialet dokumenterer beskeden. Testklienten kunne derfor ikke bruges til to-mikrofon-QA. Årsagen er ikke fastslået. Ingen konto- eller voice-konfiguration ændret; Testing og faktisk samtale-/mute-test er fortsat åbne.

cards.name: Controller: tre HUD-handlinger uden gamepad-sti, sprint-lås og terminal-luk
cards.description:
Status 6/9/2026: rettet og PUBLICERET v1764 (bekræftet i Studio Version History). Testing beholdes til fysisk device-QA.

Implementeret:
[x] Missionshjælp DPadUp/H med enhedstilpasset keycap.
[x] Dispatch-mute LB/M; mute/stop respekterer aktive paneler.
[x] Spectate DPadLeft/Right + Q/E respekterer GUI-fokus/menu.
[x] Shift/L2 genlæses under lobby/runde på alle controller-slots; fokustab rydder fysiske hold uden at slå touch-RUN fra.
[x] Terminal B-luk kun ved åbent panel, fokus på synlig aktuel fane og sikker gendannelse.
[x] NYT: Level 3 Table Hiding Client ignorerer UI-behandlet B og fokuseret tekstinput, så menu-luk ikke også forlader bordet. Normal E/B/X/leave bevares.

Verificeret 6/9:
- 46/46 applikationschecks: 16 fuldt hiding-script, 18 fuldt sprint-script, 12 uændret terminal-navigation-blok. Før rettelsen fejlede 4 hiding-checks; efter 0.
- Rigtig Studio L1: H åbner/lukker; Shift hastighed 26→16.
- Rigtig L3: bordprompt, kamerankeret, typing E beholder cover, normalt E forlader med bevægelse gendannet.

Mangler før Done: fysisk controller kiosk→Settings→B, mission/mute, spectate med flere mål, L2-disconnect og keyboard/controller-skift; endelig touch-device playtest. Ingen gamepads tilsluttet. Roblox afviser virtuel B som CoreGUI-reserveret; fixtures er ikke hardwaretest.

Oprindelig korttekst bevaret lokalt i work/trello-finish-2026-09-06/controller-card.before.md. Tidligere plan: docs/TRELLO_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_2026-09-05.md.
